title: Mike Todasco: What It Means to Be an AI-First Company

turns.speaker: Mike Todasco
paragraphs: We all need to be AI first companies. AI is just going to be is ubiquitous if not more as just being on the internet. And to do that, you got to start with these steps. Number one, I would say is focus on the customer, the experience of the customer. Don't get so tied up on the product. Two, you want to build a culture of innovation if you want to thrive as a company. And three, you need to encourage innovation and experimentation. Give your employees the tools, give them the ability to try this, give them the permission to fail sometimes, show them that you do it yourself as part of that.
